jobs.title: Faculty Clinical Coordinator - Surgical Technology
jobs.description: The faculty clinical coordinator is responsible for acquiring, contracting, monitoring, and evaluating all clinical sites for courses and student experiences. In coordination with the program administrator, this role will arrange the clinical schedule at the facilities and forecast clinical needs for upcoming semesters. The faculty clinical coordinator will be responsible for helping to coordinate and arrange internship/practicum/clinical and lab classes.
